QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Friends of Aran
QuestInfo.0: Lilin seems more excited than usual. More excited than ever, actually.
QuestInfo.1: #p1105012# thinks it would be best for you to go with someone who recognizes you as a hero. She suggested #p1012100#, but what about her? She seemed to dodge your questions when asked, but you wonder why she wouldn't want to go.
QuestInfo.2: #p1012100# thanked you for your good timing and asked you to escort her to #m130000000#.

0.0: There's no time to waste, Aran! You can't spend all day hanging around here with me. You've got to get to that conference! You should go with someone who already recognizes you as a hero.\r\n#L0# #bUmm...#l\n#k
0.1: #p1012100#, the bowman instructor in #m100000000# remembers you, right? She's one of the most respected people on Victoria Island!\r\n#L0##bWhat about you? Aren't you going, #p1105012#?#l\n#k
0.2: W-what? You wouldn't want me. This letter's just for you. I-I'll think about it, okay? Meanwhile, go see #b#p1012100##k.\r\n\r\n#b(When you accept, you will move to the Bowman Instructional School.)#l

no.0: This letter is just for you, Aran. Don't you think you deserve this for all the hard work you've done?

1.0: Aran! I was just looking to contact you. Empress #p1101000# has called for a...\r\n#L0# #bContinental Conference?#l\n#k
1.1: You already know! You couldn't write a grocery list without #p1101000# knowing.\r\n#L0# #bDo you want to go there together?#l\n#k
1.2: I think that would be a great idea. I hear even Mercedes will be there!\r\n#L0# #bWho's Mercedes?#l\n#k
1.3: Right, your memory...\r\nDon't worry about it. Mercedes is a friend.
